scenarios.title: ⚡ Urgent Electricity Disconnection Notice

data.message: Dear Consumer, your electricity bill is unpaid. Power supply will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM. Immediately call officer Sharma at 9876543210 or click http://quick-power-bill-pay.xyz/update to verify payment.

scenarios.summary: Impersonates utility provider using extreme time urgency and fear of service cutoff.

scenarios.title: 🎁 Lottery / Reward UPI 'Collect' Trap

data.message: Congratulations! You have won a cash reward of Rs. 25,000 from KBC Lucky Draw. To receive your prize in your bank, accept the payment collect request in your UPI app and enter your PIN now.

scenarios.summary: Classic collect-request deception tricking victim into entering UPI PIN under the belief they will receive money.

scenarios.title: 🏦 Bank KYC / ₹2 Verification Trap

data.message: Your SBI NetBanking profile is suspended due to pending KYC update. Pay nominal verification fee of Rs 2 immediately to reactivate your account.

scenarios.summary: Coerces user to pay a small ₹2 verification fee on a spoofed portal to steal credentials and authorize mandates.

scenarios.title: 💼 Work From Home / YouTube Rating Task

data.message: Part-time job offer! Earn Rs 3000 to 5000 daily from home just by liking YouTube videos. Deposit Rs 1000 prepaid registration charge to activate your daily payout account.

scenarios.summary: Promises guaranteed daily income for trivial online tasks, requesting an upfront prepaid deposit.

scenarios.title: 🛒 Legitimate Local Grocery Purchase

data.message: Your bill at Fresh Daily Supermart is Rs 340. Thank you for shopping with us. Invoice has been saved to your account.

scenarios.summary: Normal merchant payment pattern with legitimate verified handle, HTTPS receipt, and no coercive cues.
